why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against its expect line. Checks 1, 2 and 4 hold. Check 1 tests below, above and inside the range, the bounds, and lo === hi, all of which "returns x limited to the range lo to hi" forces. Check 2 tests only that lo > hi gives a RangeError. Check 4 tests only exit status 0 with no failing tests. Check 3 breaks the criterion. Its PASS condition requires "its name and signature plus a description of what it does." The expect line says only "README.md documents every function math.js exports". A signature is something those words don't force, and it isn't under Advisory. The FAIL condition also doesn't mention a missing signature ("missing ... or is only named with no description"), so the PASS rule is stricter than the line. That extra signature requirement fails the criterion.
